dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Rana said she was leaving for a trip and would be away for a very long time, much longer than before...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: But since I'm older than Sudabeh and Iotham, I'll take care of them for her!

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: Let's play with Rana once she gets back!
